briefNote: Normalized production briefs; existing front desktop illustrations are reused.

assets.brief: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE production mobile portrait background 1024x1536 (2:3). Reference exact courtyard of Code Destiny Moonlit Lotus Temple. Recompose SAME FRONT viewpoint and same physical architecture, objects and colors for a TALL phone screen. Show complete shrine/roof or bridge and lake landmarks in upper 65%, golden pig Buddha with pink lotus where present, music box left and moktak right where present. Widen the EMPTY stone floor or clear walkway at bottom center, with room for a separately overlaid animated character. Preserve watercolor/gouache storybook warmth, peach wood and stones, lavender moonlight, pink lotuses. This is a new portrait composition, NOT a tight crop cutting off shrine. No text, no UI, no living characters, no borders, no extra shrine or duplicate statue.

Use case: illustration-story. ONE production MOBILE PORTRAIT 1024x1536 background for Code Destiny Moonlit Lotus Temple. Use reference exact courtyard, same watercolor storybook style, same architecture and objects, but change camera viewpoint 22 degrees to the LEFT, looking diagonally toward the golden pig Buddha shrine. Perspective must really change: roof, pillars and paving converge diagonally, show correct side of building; not a crop or mirror. Compose specifically for tall phone, entire main shrine roof/landmarks and golden pig statue pink lotus where present fit within middle 85% width and upper 65% height. Music box stays physically left, moktak physically right if present. Generous EMPTY clear peach stone floor or pathway BOTTOM CENTER for an animated character. Preserve warm watercolor/gouache, peach wood/stone, purple roofs, lavender moonlight, pink lotuses. No living characters, no text, UI, border, duplicate landmarks or statue.

Use case: illustration-story. Production landscape background for Code Destiny Moonlit Lotus Temple. Reference is the exact courtyard, its watercolor style, architecture and objects are authoritative. Create ONE 1536x1024 landscape illustration of the SAME place viewed by a camera moved 45 degrees to the LEFT of the original viewpoint, looking diagonally toward the golden pig Buddha shrine. True new perspective, not a crop or mirror: floor paving and roof and pillars recede toward the shrine. Preserve the golden pig statue with pink lotus, purple roof/curtains, warm lanterns, music box physically at the left, moktak physically at the right; keep side-specific objects in correct physical positions. Match warm hand-painted storybook watercolor/gouache, peach stone and wood, pink lotuses, lavender moonlight. Keep complete shrine/statue in middle 70%, generous EMPTY clear floor bottom middle for a separately animated character. No living characters, text, UI, panels, borders, duplicates or photorealism.
